name: lifesync
description: LifeSync: personal and professional life management

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @lifesync/server" "npm run dev -w @lifesync/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lifesync/server && npm run build -w @lifesync/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w @lifesync/server" "npm run start -w @lifesync/web"
